summary: Mobile UI and core ride flow tested successfully; backend catalog, estimate, history, and validation passed. Public health URL is misrouted to the Expo app.

critical.issue: GET on the configured public endpoint returns the Expo HTML shell (200) rather than the backend JSON health payload. Backend health works internally, but public ingress only routes /api/*.

ui_bugs.issue: The top-left close/back Pressable has no testID or accessibility label, preventing robust automated interaction; the live trip screen itself rendered correctly.

action_items: Expose health through the public ingress (for example an /api/health route or ingress mapping) while retaining the internal probe.
Align frontend API configuration with the required EXPO_BACKEND_URL key, or explicitly document the intentional EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL contract.
Add testID/accessibilityLabel to the trip close control.
critical_code_review_comments: src/api.ts reads EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL and Constants extra backendUrl, but the environment contract specifies EXPO_BACKEND_URL; missing configuration can produce a malformed API URL.
No authentication flow exists despite Google/email/phone access methods being selected; profile sign-in is currently a navigation stub to booking rather than sign-in.

success_rate.backend: 66% (2/3 regression tests; public health routing failed)
success_rate.frontend: 100% of executed UI assertions passed; close control automation was blocked by missing label

seed_data_creation: No new seed data created; existing persisted booking data was read. The earlier app state already contained demo bookings.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Home, Explore, destination selection, booking estimate, booking confirmation, live trip, Trips, and Profile all rendered successfully at 375x667. Public /health returned Expo HTML; /api catalog and ride endpoints passed.
rca_of_issue: Ingress behavior sends non-/api public paths to the frontend, while FastAPI health is declared at root /health. The frontend API client also does not read the mandated EXPO_BACKEND_URL variable.
